why_text: To check how you are feeling generally today before looking at your numbers.
template_en: How are you feeling today? Any symptoms you would like to report?
template_ur: آج آپ کیسا محسوس کر رہے ہیں؟ کیا آپ کوئی علامت بتانا چاہتے ہیں؟
template_roman_ur: Aaj aap kaisa mehsoos kar rahe hain? Kya koi alamat batana chahte hain?
review_status: proposed, not reviewed by a clinician

why_text: To understand how you feel if you were not able to measure your reading today.
template_en: No problem. Can you tell me roughly how you have been feeling instead (for example more thirsty than usual, tired, or dizzy)? If you do have a reading, please share it.
template_ur: کوئی بات نہیں۔ کیا آپ بتا سکتے ہیں کہ آپ کیسا محسوس کر رہے ہیں (مثلاً پیاس زیادہ لگنا، تھکاوٹ، یا چکر آنا)؟ اگر آپ کے پاس ریڈنگ ہے تو ضرور بتائیں۔
template_roman_ur: Koi baat nahi. Kya aap bata sakte hain ke aap kaisa mehsoos kar rahe hain (maslan pyas ziada lagna, thakawat, ya chakkar aana)? Agar reading hai toh zaroor batayein.
review_status: proposed, not reviewed by a clinician

why_text: To make sure anything else on your mind is shared directly with your care team.
template_en: Is there anything else you would like your clinician to know about your health today?
template_ur: کیا کوئی اور بات ہے جو آپ آج اپنی میڈیکل ٹیم کے علم میں لانا چاہتے ہیں؟
template_roman_ur: Kya koi aur baat hai jo aap aaj apni medical team ko batana chahte hain?
review_status: proposed, not reviewed by a clinician

why_text: To confirm we noted your answers correctly before saving.
template_en: Here is what we have recorded today. Does everything look right to you?
template_ur: ہم نے آج یہ معلومات درج کی ہیں۔ کیا سب کچھ ٹھیک ہے؟
template_roman_ur: Hum ne aaj yeh maloomat darj ki hain. Kya sab theek hai?
review_status: proposed, not reviewed by a clinician
